description_en: Queries a list of APIs in the development state
description_zh: 调用ListDataServiceApis获取数据服务API开发中的信息列表
name: ListDataServiceApis

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大50条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. To obtain the tenant ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console). Find your workspace and go to the DataStudio page. On the DataStudio page, click the logon username in the upper-right corner and click User Info in the Menu section
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword in API names. The keyword is used to search for the APIs whose names contain the keyword
parameters.help_zh: API名称的关键词，过滤得到API名称包含该关键词的API
parameters.name: api_name_keyword

parameters.help_en: The keyword in API paths. The keyword is used to search for the APIs whose paths contain the keyword
parameters.help_zh: API路径的关键词，过滤得到API路径包含该关键词的API
parameters.name: api_path_keyword

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the creator of the APIs. The ID is used to search for the APIs created by the creator
parameters.help_zh: API创建者的阿里云ID，过滤得到该用户创建的API
parameters.name: creator_id

Apis.description_en: The list of APIs in the development state

ApiMode.description_en: The type of the API. Valid values: 0, 1, and 2. The value 0 indicates that the API is generated in wizard mode. The value 1 indicates that the API is generated in script mode. The value 2 indicates that the API is generated by registration
ApiMode.description_zh: API的类型，可选枚举值包括0（向导API）、1（脚本API）和2（注册API）

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the API was created
CreatedTime.description_zh:
创建时间。

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ`，例如 `2020-06-23T00:21:01+0800`；该示例的时区偏移为 `+0800`

CreatorId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the creator of the API

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the API was last modified

OperatorId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the user who last modified the API

ParameterOperator.description_en: The operator used for the value of the parameter. Valid values: 0, 1, 2, and 3. The value 0 indicates the Equal operator. The value 1 indicates the Like operator. The value 2 indicates the Const operator. The value 3 indicates the In operator. APIs generated in wizard mode support the Equal, Like, and In operators. APIs generated in script mode support the Equal operator. APIs generated by registration support the Equal and Const operators
ParameterOperator.description_zh: 运算符，可选枚举值包括0（Equal）、1（Like）、2（Const）和3（In）。向导模式API支持Equal、Like和In，脚本模式API支持Equal，注册API支持Equal和Const

ParameterPosition.description_en: The position of the parameter. Valid values: 0, 1, 2, and 3. The value 0 indicates that the parameter is in the URL path of the request. The value 1 indicates that the parameter is in the Query parameter of the request URL. The value 2 indicates that the parameter is in the request header. The value 3 indicates that the parameter is in the request body. APIs generated in wizard or script mode support only the Query position. APIs generated by registration whose request method is GET or DELETE support the Query and Head positions. APIs generated by registration whose request method is PUT or POST support the Query, Head, and Body positions
ParameterPosition.description_zh: 参数的位置，可选枚举值包括0（Path）、1（Query）、2（Head）和3（Body）。向导和脚本API仅支持Query。注册API中的GET、DELETE方法支持Query、Head，PUT、POST方法支持Query、Head和Body

ServiceContentType.description_en: The format in which the response of the API request is returned. Valid values: 0 and 1. The value 0 indicates the JSON format. The value 1 indicates the XML format. APIs generated in wizard or script mode support the JSON format. APIs generated by registration support the JSON and XML formats
ServiceContentType.description_zh: API的返回数据类型，可选枚举值包括0（JSON）和1（XML）。向导和脚本API支持JSON，注册API支持JSON和XML
